## Download

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `YTDownloadManager-Setup-x64.exe` | Windows, 64-bit (most PCs) |
| `YTDownloadManager-Setup-x86.exe` | Windows, 32-bit |
| `YTStandaloneDownloader-Extension.zip` | The browser extension alone (Linux, macOS, or without the app) |
| `yt-standalone-downloader.user.js` | The userscript, for Tampermonkey |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums of all files above |

How to install and update: see the [README](https://github.com/NyxiYT/yt-download-manager#installation).
After updating, click the reload icon on the extension's card in `chrome://extensions` and refresh your YouTube tabs.

Like the app? You can [support the project](https://github.com/NyxiYT/yt-download-manager#support-the-project).
